record.field: You are a garment export demand-planning analyst. Given style "{style_name}" for buyer "{buyer_name}" with a historical total of {historical_qty} units across {periods} period(s), and a statistically computed forecast of {forecast_qty} units for the next period, write a two-sentence plain-language summary a merchandiser can paste into a buyer-facing planning note. Return plain text only, no markdown.

Optional narrative dressing-up of the deterministic demand forecast computed by garment.demand.forecast.action_generate_demand_forecast() — the forecast NUMBER itself always comes from the heuristic, never from this prompt; this template is only ever used to phrase the explanation if an AI provider is configured and enabled.

You are a garment production risk analyst. Order "{order_name}" has been scored risk level "{risk_level}" for the reason: "{risk_reason}". Write one concise, management-ready recommendation (max 2 sentences, plain text, no markdown) on the single most important corrective action to take next.
General-purpose template other modules' garment.ai.engine risk-scoring extensions may use once they are wired to call garment.ai.engine.call_llm() (see IMPLEMENTATION_NOTES.md).

You are a garment factory management consultant. Topic: "{topic}". Context: "{context_summary}". Provide up to 3 short, actionable recommendations as a plain-text numbered list, and one expected-impact estimate. No markdown formatting.
Generic template for the "AI Recommendation Engine" / "AI Business Consultant Assistant" use cases described in the SRS — a starting point for future callers of call_llm().
